name: Drawer
author: romeo
description: Hides chosen bar widgets behind a single bar icon and gives them back as a popup menu, with their panels and click actions intact.

barWidget.description: A popup menu holding bar widgets you would rather not see all the time.

schema.label: Hidden widgets
schema.description: Managed from the drawer's own list: each entry records a widget id plus the section and neighbour it came from, so showing it again puts it back in place.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: grid, squares, tiles, apps, hamburger, kebab, dots, inbox, folder, layers, brick, puzzle, or chevron (which follows the bar edge).

schema.label: View
schema.description: list for one row per widget, grid for a block of icon tiles.

schema.label: Icons per row
schema.description: How many tiles the grid puts on each row, 2 to 8. Grid view only.

schema.label: Show names under the icons
schema.description: Grid view only. Off keeps the grid to bare icons, with the name on hover.

schema.label: Show how many are hidden
schema.description: Paints the number of hidden widgets next to the drawer icon.

schema.label: Close when a widget is opened
schema.description: Off keeps the drawer open behind the widget's own panel.

schema.label: Hide the drawer when it is empty
schema.description: Takes the icon off the bar until something is hidden.
